title: Document admitted Engram source warning stderr in the metadata probe contract
outcome: Source-owner documentation describes the warning stderr admitted by the Rust metadata/schema and source probes, while distinguishing the strict version probe and unchanged refusal boundaries.
acceptance: docs/test.md describes status-0-only admission of complete supported Engram slow-operation warning lines, the two supported operation forms, the 262144-byte payload bound and emission after successful validation.

The documentation makes clear that unsupported, malformed, mixed, oversized or non-zero-status stderr is refused, that executable/source/envelope/root guards remain independent, and that --version still refuses nonempty stderr.
The change is documentation only and adds no tests that read repository Markdown or instruction text.
